message.content: Proposed 3 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: Anonymize manuscript for double-blind review: replace author name/affiliation with "Anonymous", drop the lab-naming Acknowledgments, and blind the self-citation (renamed key + placeholder entry in refs.bib).

hunks.oldText: The results use the public Atlas dataset and retain the necessary self-citation \cite{our2023}.
hunks.newText: The results use the public Atlas dataset and retain the necessary citation \cite{anonymized}.
